entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last month.
Okay, no problem at all. Do you have the order number handy?
Great, one moment... Okay, I see it. Looks like it was delivered 41 days ago. You're well within the 90 days, so we can definitely get that returned for you.
Oh, perfect. That's great news. What do I need to do?
I've just approved the return on my end. I am emailing you a prepaid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes.
Wow, that was fast. So I just print the label and send it back?
That's it. Just pack the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we get it back at the warehouse, your refund will be processed.
Excellent. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Nope, that was all. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
